description:
Fixed speed, red-light and point-to-point camera counts per suburb and the distance to the nearest camera, for New South Wales and the ACT.

Coverage: New South Wales and the ACT only. Other states return no data. Current to 2026-10-28. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/speed-cameras`.

**Price: 3¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: cameras_total, fixed_cameras, red_light_cameras, point_to_point_cameras, nearest_camera_m. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: suburbs_transport_speed_cameras
title: Suburb · Speed and red-light cameras
